name: Studds Accessories Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1975,Studds Accessories Limited is a manufacturer of two-wheeler helmets and motorcycle accessories.[1]
keyPoints:
Market Leadership[1]
Studds Accessories Limited is the largest two-wheeler helmet manufacturer in India by revenue and the world’s largest by volume. It designs, manufactures, and sells helmets and related accessories under its mass-market brand Studds and premium brand SMK, selling ~7.4 million helmets in FY25.

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 17.2%
